facts.text: The party owes Warwick metal brought back from the Dwarven mine to the north. Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre, using it every night, until they return.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor, after the Dwarven mine trip. Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril shirt over his leather armor, on loan. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance, blocking the metal owed to Warwick. It can be dug through; Dunk has broken in far enough to uncover a dead dwarf's arm.
